Largest 24h duplicate-charge rate increase follows payment-service v2.14.0 at 2026-10-12T14:00:00+00:00: 1.2% (4/323 orders) -> 7.8% (24/308). Change: Reduce provider client timeout from 10s to 3s to speed up checkout
